item.description: API calls which are custom to the Marand/Better.care ThinkEHr CDR.

These resources belong to the [Better Ehrscape API](https://dev.ehrscape.com/api-explorer.html) - see 'Electronic Health Record APIs'.

This API is supported by the Better CDR and Ethercis.

request.description: Merges EHRs by moving all compositions from source EHR to target EHR. Reversible operation. Both source and target EHRs must be in the same (caller's) domain.
Un-merges EHRs by moving compositions that have once been merged to sourceEhr back to targetEhr. Leave record indicating EHRs were merged.

Completely removes the EHR from the system, including all its compositions, statuses, tags, contributions and folders. EHR must be in the caller's domain. This is a physical delete and not logical - EHR with all of it's data will be removed from the server. WARNING! After this call there is no way to get EHR (with all its related data) back - it will be permanently removed from the system.

Completely removes all compositions that have a newer version, created in the specified time period, from the system. Date and time format for query parameters is in ISO format (e.g. 2017-06-20T09:22:38.681Z). Response describes what was done. WARNING! After this call there is no way to get removed data back.

item.name: Move composition from source EHR to target EHR.

request.description: Moves all versions of the composition (must pass 'compositionUid' without system ID or version). Move only possible when both EHRs are in the same (caller's) domain. WARNING! After this call there is no way to know that composition was originally in the source EHR.

Completely removes all composition versions from the system. Specified composition's system ID and version are ignored. This is a physical delete and not logical. WARNING! After this call there is no way to get composition back.

item.name: Move all compositions from source EHR to target EHR.

request.description: WARNING! After this call there is no way to know which compositions on target EHR have been there originally and which ones have been moved from source EHR. Both source and target EHRs must be in the same (caller's) domain.
If type is specified, returns all events of that type. Actual JSON representation of returned events depends on their type.

Events of different types have different properties:
 * JS event
```
{
    "name": "test_js",
    "active": false,
    "phase": "POST_COMMIT",
    "aqlString": "select c from composition c limit 1;",
    "domain": "default",
    "javascript": "someFunction();",
    "eventType": "JS"
}
```

* Push event
```
{
    "name": "test_push",
    "active": false,
    "phase": "POST_COMMIT",
    "aqlString": "select c from composition c limit 1;",
    "domain": "default",
    "type": "something",
    "destination": "http://www.example.com",
    "eventType": "PUSH",
    "retryIntervalMillis": 600000,
    "timeToLiveMillis": 43200000}
```

* Queue event
```
{
    "name": "test_queue",
    "active": false,
    "phase": "POST_COMMIT",
    "aqlString": "select c from composition c limit 1;",
    "domain": "default",
    "type": "json",
    "topic": "EhrEvents",
    "partition": null,
    "eventType": "QUEUE"
}
```
By default only last versions of forms are retrieved. To get all versions of all forms use 'allVersions=true' query parameter. Forms are returned in a ZIP file.

Form file is a JAR (or ZIP with a manifest) file with form contents, or a ZIP file that contains only JAR (or ZIP with manifest) form files.

File is uploaded as binary data and content type header application/octet-stream must be set.

Can return all versions of the form, if no specific version is given and 'allVersions=true' parameter is passed. Only the latest form will be returned when no parameters are given. Results are returned in a single- or multi-form ZIP file.
Can delete all versions of the form if no specific version is given and 'allVersions=true' parameter is passed. When no parameters are given, only the latest form will be deleted.
Returns all users with all password fields set to null.
Returns the user with specified username with all password fields set to null.

item.name: Reindex stored compositions from the last specified number of hours.
Returns templates - all or single by ID.

request.description:
By default, all active templates are returned, without XML data included. Parameter 'includeInactive' controls whether inactive templates are returned, parameter 'includeXmls' controls whether XML data is returned in results.

Call also supports two ID parameters - 'templateId' will return the last template with the given template ID, 'id' will return the template by its ID. Parameter 'includeInactive' can be used with 'templateId' to return the currently active template and all previous, inactive ones. XML data is returned only when 'includeXmls=true' is passed. Both 'templateId' and 'id' parameters can be used simultaneously, but it is somewhat redundant and will return a template by its ID only if a call without 'id' parameter would contain it.

Template file is either an XML file, or a ZIP file that contains several template XML files.

File is uploaded as binary data and content type header application/octet-stream must be set.
Returns template by its template ID. By using 'includeInactive=true' parameter, all inactive templates will be returned as well. Template XML can be omitted by passing 'includeXmls=false'.
Permanently delete all active and inactive templates for a given template ID. If parameter 'id' is given as well, only delete that specific one.
Only works if template is active. Otherwise, a 404 error is returned.

Without giving the 'id' parameter, method will unretire last template. When 'id' parameter is given, specific template will be found and unretired. This will only work when all instances of the template are inactive.
